notes.title: First Multiplayer Gameplay Release!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi guys![/h1]

We are excited to announce the release of the first multiplayer gameplay of our game on Steam.

We have worked tirelessly to deliver a smooth multiplayer experience. In this gameplay, you will see some of the game mechanics, graphics, and gameplay that we have meticulously designed.

[previewyoutube=_TaimWqDLZM;full][/previewyoutube]

We are eager to hear your feedback and suggestions to keep improving and take this experience to an even higher level. Don’t forget to leave your comments and follow us for more updates!

Add [u][b]Project Nightmares Multiplayer[/b][/u] to your wishlist and download the demo now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2800850/Project_Nightmares_Multiplayer/

We also invite you to join our community on Discord. Connect with other players, share your experiences, and get the latest updates directly from the development team.

https://discord.com/invite/petRMS3kqw

See you in the playtest very soon!

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hi guys!
In this third patch we have fixed some bugs.
It is very important that you let us know if something is not working so we can fix it. We also look at the different Streamers to detect failures and check the stability of the game.

Discord: https://discord.gg/XrSVxR4g

[h3][u][b]MODIFICATION[/b][/u][/h3]
We increased the number of candles to double the amount.

[h3][u][b]FIXED BUGS[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where if when closing the valve, just at that moment we continue interacting repeatedly, the IK system is blocked and the player is looking at the floor in the restart.
[*] Fixed bug in the sacrifice room. When Henrietta kills us and at the same time a trap is killing us, in the restart the movement is blocked.
[*] Fixed bug where when closing the valve and after dying, when trying again with the same valve the hand animation remains in the closed position.
[*] Fixed bug where you can light the candle in the portal room from the outside of the room.
[*] Fixed bug in the dark room where after solving the quest the key remains on the floor.
[*] Fixed bug in the dark room where after solving the quest, you can interact with the lectern in the middle of the scarecrow cinematic.
[*] Fixed bug where we could grab items when we open the top drawer and immediately take the item from the bottom drawer.  
[*] Fixed arm whip that would occur after the player lit the candle as a result of repeated mouse movements. 
[/list]

[h3][u]TRANSLATIONS[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] We have the Korean language fully translated but we need to convert the final text to subtitles. If someone can help us, we would appreciate it.
[*] We are looking for Japanese translation. We are still exchanging languages for keys.
[/list]

Cheers!
Ignacio & Claudio.
NCStudio

notes.title: Changes in mechanics and bug fixes.
notes.notes:
Hi guys!
 
In this release week we have been watching the different gameplays on twitch and youtube. To all of you who have been following us all the way through Early Access you know that we have been using the different streamers to evaluate bugs and changes in the game mechanics. This is because we are not a big studio with a lot of people to evaluate and test mechanics. The streamers are a nexus with many players and our interaction happens mostly through those places.
As we are only two people, and only one of us writes the code alone, we need to be sure of what we are going to change, because any change takes time in design, creating new models, modifying art, modifying things related to programming, and we have to do it as soon as possible.
That's why, after seeing different streamers we have fixed different bugs and we also decided to change some mechanics to make the game a little bit more friendly to those who play it for the first time. 
[b]Project Nightmares[/b] is a challenging game. Our idea was never to make an easy game. Again, there is nothing random about the game. If you think that to pass a level, you must try all the options by dying over and over again, it is because you are not paying attention to the environment and the clues, (We have seen this a lot in the cemetery, or in the corridors of the last part). It is not a game for speedrunners.  
Discord: https://discord.gg/XrSVxR4g

[h3][u][b]GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] We had increased the time on the 4 rotating pieces puzzle that is behind the mansion picture to make it easier.
[*] We have put a light in Anna's eyes to mark where she is looking when she is leaning on the wall to make it easier. 
[*] We have cancelled the detection of running, when Anna is on the wall. Now you will be able to run and Anna will not detect you. This way it will be easier to pass through. 
[*] In the mission to kill Henrietta we have made the steam combinations simpler to make it easier to pass through.
[*] We have put a warning in the library so that it is understood that if you run in that area, you die.
[*] We have put a warning in the sacrifice room to do not approach the fence.
[*] We have changed the gameplay in the sacrifice room for the pillar mission. Now every time you approach the grates, Henrietta will always come out with a gameplay.
[*] We have changed the gameplay in the mission where you must leave the sacrifice room dizzy. You will have 1 gameplay if you approach the fence, but at the second time, you will die.
[*] We have changed the gameplay of Henrietta behind the bars giving a recovery time, after the gameplay. After the recovery time we will be able to receive another attack. 
[*] We have added a general light that will make it easier to exit the sacrifice corridor.   
[*] We have modified the hint in the cemetery puzzle after the correct completion of the arms and urns puzzle. The correct niche code is in another place.
[*] We modified Anna's teleport particles when we have to look for the gears.
[*] Corrected Anna's hearing range in the gear room so that she doesn't detect us from far away.
[*] Corrected Anna's visual range in the columns so that it is according to the distance of the light from her eyes. 
[/list]

[h3][u][b]FIXED BUGS[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug related to disabling the shadow. When the user deactivate the shadow, the puzzle animation of the gear room was blocked due to the lack of projection of the shadow in front of the camera and the animation was considered by the engine as inactive.
[*] We have fixed the bug that occurred when playing without crosshair. When we removed the crosshair from the menu, some gameplays were blocked. 
[*] Fixed bug where Anna runs us to the door. When opening the door the arm was in a bad position displaced from the screen.   
[*] Fixed bug where Anna runs to the door. Sometimes if we stood behind the door and closed just when it was on the threshold, the door was closed and Anna went through it.
[*] Fixed bug where Anna runs us to the door. The game remained with an incorrect state and the game was blocked.
[*] Fixed bug where Anna runs to the door. When the player made an interaction and then used the monocle, Anna did not attack us.
[*] Fixed bug where Anna runs to the door. When the player went with the active monocle and Anna came out in the corridor, when the player took out the monocle and used it again, Anna didn't kill us.
[*] Fixed bug where Anna runs us to the salt wall and explodes in the salt wall. If we run immediatly very fast forward, it shoots again, kills us and blocks the game on restart.
[*] Fixed bug where the player runs towards the door and when interacting to open it, he is on the other side of the door. If the door was blocked, the player was locked in the room. 
[*] Fixed bug when closing the door on the right side but right in the middle of the door threshold. It twisted the player and left him on the inside side of the room, instead of leaving him outside the room. 
[*] Fixed bug where the right hand crosses in front of the camera when closing or opening doors, when grabbing any object with the left hand, or when playing cinematics. 
[*] Corrected the closing of the door of the room of the necronomicon. At leaving the room, when Henrietta's chase starts, we could enter the room.
[*] Corrected the closing of the door of the Necronomicon's room. When exiting and dying anywhere in the corridor in mission 8, after the restart, the Necronomicon room disappeared and if we entered to the room, we fell to the emptiness. 
[*] Fixed bug where the final missions are blocked if we didn't die after cemetery.
[*] The texts of the mission 2 were completed with the Italian language.
[/list]

[h3][u]What are we doing?[/u][/h3]
Several polishing improvements in general. Maybe we will change some more mechanics. We are thinking of exiting the autoloading and putting a mission loader from the menu so you can enter the missions you went through. 

[h3][u]Some upcoming fixes.[/u][/h3]
[u]Extremely rare bugs.[/u]
[list]
[*] When the candle goes out, sometimes, not always, when Anna exits the autosave and kills us, after restarting, the camera remains outside the model. You have to exit to the menu and re-enter to continue. 
[*] There is a steam pipe bug in the mission to kill Henrietta where the steam mechanics breaks and the steam doesn't kill us, and there is no sound.  
[/list]
[u]Common bug.[/u]
[list]
[*] When the candle is lit, the wrist is twisted at the end of the candle interaction.
[*] When there are 3 drawers and we open the top drawer, and that same moment we want to take an item from the bottom drawer, it takes the item through the top drawer. 
[/list]

[h3][u]TRANSLATIONS[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] We have the Korean language fully translated but we need to convert the final text to subtitles. If someone can help us, we would appreciate it.
[*] We are looking for Japanese translation. We are still exchanging languages for keys.
[/list]

Cheers!
Ignacio & Claudio.
NCStudio

notes.title: Version 1.0.009
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.009 has arrived.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/rcFVmSy/piano2.jpg[/img]
[h1][i] What’s new? [/i][/h1]
[list]
[*] We made some focus on the playability. We change the entire gameflow of the previous version. The main problem of version 1.0.008 was the gameflow, and how the player tried to solve the situations to move forward. 
Some puzzles were too hard, so we changed the difficulty. On the other hand, in the mission 1 you had to go all over the house just to find 3 photos. 
We have changed that, and the game design became linear, therefore, we will be much more oriented. Therefore, we focus on balancing the playability of this version.
[*] We added new puzzles.
[*] We have been created new gameplays.
[*] We reduced the complexity of the puzzle with sliding pieces.
[*] We created a different Anna's AI
[*] We modify the time of falling when the player doesn't have a candle
[*] Hungarian translation was added and German was completed.
[*] We created and changed some graphics details in the canvas, loading, and in the level.
[/list]

[h1][i] What has been fixed? [/i][/h1]
[list]
[*] We fixed a bug related to doors.
[*] We fixed a bug related to Henrietta.
[*] We fixed a bug related to the player.
[*] We fixed a bug related to the move of the hand in some interactions.
[*] We fixed some translations errors.
[*] We decreased the chance of falling when running without a light.
[*] We fixed a problem related to the secondary mission.
[*] We fixed the camera movement in some interactions.
[/list]

[h1][i] What will be the next? [/i][/h1]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/pbYLMSW/inferno.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] We are working on chapter 2 and a completely different situations to face.
[*] New missions. 
[*] New scenario.
[*] New gameplays.
[*] New puzzles.
[*] A little more of the story...
 [/list]


[h1][i] Translations. [/i][/h1]
IMPORTANT: We are exchanging copies of the game for translations.
Translations to other languages such as Italian, French, Chinese 中国人, Japanese 日本語, Korean 한국어 are still unavailable. [i] If you think you can help us with the translation into your language, please contact us at: contact@projectnightmares.com [/i]
Thanks to Faisal Nadhim we have arabic support, but first we have to integrate it to the game in the correct way.

Brechler Zsolt (Hungarian Translation)

notes.title: Version 1.0.0082
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.0082.

[h1][i] Bug Fixed [/i][/h1]
[list]
[*] The portrait of mission two is rotated when you put Continue from the menu
[*] We fixed a bug that stop the game in the sliding puzzle
[*] We fixed a salt dish bug that stop the game
[*] We fixed a salt dish bug who stick the dish to the hand 
[*] We fixed a bug where the candle melt down while the player is solving the puzzle
[*] We fixed a bug where the interaction was blocked.
[*] We fixed a gamepad bug on the main menu
[*] We fixed a bug in mission 4 where the model was broken.
[*] Several visual problems were corrected.
[*] Some texts were corrected
[*] Fixed several sound issues.
[*] We fixed the drawing in the final mission.
[*] Different interactions were synchronized to avoid jumps with the IK system.
[*] Fixed a fps drop in the safe box.
[/list]

[h1][i] What's new? [/i][/h1]
[list]
[*] The FOV parameter was added. We recommend keeping the FOV low for screens with an aspect ratio wide such as 16:9, 16:10, 32:9, etc. and an FOV of 85 or 90 for screens with an aspect ratio of 4:3, 5:4, etc.
[*] The player's movement speed was modified. Now you will walk faster and run faster.
[*] The time at which the candle goes out when running was modified. (We still have to adjust this)
[*] The rotating parts puzzle was modified. Each piece has a timer, and there is a unique combination to solve it. We decided to add a system for each piece to lock it when it reaches the position.
[*] We add a button to handle a tool with the left hand and a tool with the right hand.
[*] We add some more clues.
[/list]

[h1][i] What's next? [/i][/h1]
The next version is 1.0.009. This version will have some modifications in some missions to change the gameflow.

[h1][i] Translations [/i][/h1]
In this version the Portuguese language was added, thanks to the collaboration of Shotgun (Brazil)

Follow us: https://www.facebook.com/projectnightmaresgame/

[i] Please read the following post: [/i] https://steamcommunity.com/games/projectnightmares/announcements/detail/1724202719262895003

notes.title: Version 1.0.005
notes.notes:
The version 1.0.005 has come. 
[img]https://image.ibb.co/cbFqYL/screenshot34.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] We have added a new mission.
[*] We have added a secondary mission.
[*] When you finish the mission you will earn an object that will be useful to solve some mysteries and to get useful clues or signals.
[*] We have been working on the objects that the player will be able to examine. As a sample we have loaded a few items on the house.
[*] Textures have been changed
[*] Models have been created.
[*] Antialiasing was added.
[/list]

[h1][i]What has been corrected?[/i][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a resize problem with super ultra wide monitors (32:9 and others).
[*] The canvas was adjusted to be independent of the aspect ratio.
[*] A possible bug was corrected with the door where the camera was at an impossible angle
[*] Some interaction times were corrected. The idea is to adjust these times until the cinematics do not interrupt the gameplay.
[*] The ripple noise that occurs when Henrietta kills you was corrected for some hardware. In some hardware it was really exaggerated.
[*] Some animations of the main character were corrected.
[*] English Translation (Thanks to Caleb).
[/list]

[img]https://image.ibb.co/njDf00/screenshot33.jpg[/img]

[*] The gamepad will be enabled.
[*] Graphic settings will be enabled and others will be added. ie: Blur, FOV, Depth of field (DOF), etc.
[*] Incomplete translations will be completed.
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/N24JjsT/pause544.gif[/img]

[h1][i]What we have to do?[/i][/h1]
[list]
[*] We are working to enable the sprint. This will come with a new functionality.
[*] We have to work in Henrietta AI and her animations.
[*] We have to add saves. The idea is to save the game automatically, maybe post mission (we have to define this)
[/list]


[h1][i]In another thread.[/i][/h1]
[list]
[*] We create rooms, so you can open the doors and get inside.
[*] More sections are being created on the level.
[*] More behaviors are being created for the player.
[*] More items are being created with utility

[*] The dialogues of the game are being created.
[/list]

[h1][i]Translations[/i][/h1]

notes.title: Version 1.0.004
notes.notes:
[h1]The version 1.0.004 has arrived[/h1]
The last months have been really hard, we have been working on the main structure of the game.
We worked on the objects that will illuminate our path.
The candle can turn off when we run, on fast turns, or in some specific events.
The candle will also melt. You have to look for candles in the house in case it goes out.
If you let the candle melting completely, it could burn your hand, and you would end up releasing it.
When the candle or the object that illuminates our path goes out, the paranormal entities will be able to attack us more easily. We have some plans on this point..
You must keep the X key pressed to see how many candles you are carry.
[img]https://image.ibb.co/caPv2K/39959723_2198258900244303_915357345817559040_o.jpg[/img]

The game will have several easter eggs, and we have added some new ones.
The environment will now change, the sections of the house could change every time you play. Remember, it's a nightmare.
[img]https://image.ibb.co/chDKez/pasillo3.jpg[/img]

We added a console that can be opened with F1. To watch the available codes, type "Nightmares." and the autocomplete will show you the options availables.
You can check the fps in the game with Nightmares.Showfps. To remove the fps you must type Nightmares.Hidefps
We added some new models in the house.
[img]https://image.ibb.co/bQWame/image.png[/img]

[h1]Corrections[/h1]
In these months we have fixed many bugs, and the game is much more stable
Some bugs have been fixed in the gameplays. 
Bugs were corrected in the main character, sometimes when opening doors he was decapitated lol :P
We fix a bug where the decapitated entity was spawned in impossible places
Foot slip corrected (All the animations still need to be corrected, the final version will have mocaps or that is what we want, we are collecting money for this point)
We fix the shake when Henrietta killed us face to face, that was happening in some hardwares.
[img]https://image.ibb.co/g2RGRe/pasillo2.jpg[/img]

[h1]In another thread[/h1]
We are working on new environments in the house, new paranormal entities. Some are already finished, others are being modified.
This will come only in the final version. We are creating new achievements, new missions, and they will not be easy.
[img]https://image.ibb.co/eWg3pz/37979828_2141199839283543_2793651710927568896_o.jpg[/img]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
From now on, we are gonna made updates much more often.
We will release the parameters in the options menu, graphics, keyboards, etc.
We are gonna transport this option menu to the gameplay so you could change the parameter inside the game just like other games.
A new mission will come. Henrietta animations will be fixed, new models are being created and much more ...
[img]https://image.ibb.co/bvHwbe/1500x500.jpg[/img]

Share the game with a friend!

Follow us: 
https://www.facebook.com/projectnightmaresgame/?ref=br_rs
https://www.instagram.com/projectnightmares/
